title: Beast Leap
author: BuiltUnderground
selftext:
For years, the Chrome dino kept me company through load shedding and faulty fibre. 🦖

It's fun, but the historical inaccuracies always bugged me. So I decided to give Astra and Codex a go and ended up building BEAST LEAP, a prehistoric runner stitched together from late nights, curiosity and too few resets (👀 looking at you, @Tibo).

While everyone’s out there building incredible WebGL experiences, I grew up on MS-DOS games and still have a soft spot for old-school pixel art.

I've definitely spent more time on it than I should have, but I'm kinda happy with how it turned out. 

🦖 https://beastleap.com/
